[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Sunward Marches | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=373 }} The [[Sunward Marches]] consists of rolling hilly and rocky terrain that comprises most of western [[Kourna]], and together with the [[Marga Coast]], the western coastline of Kourna. A large [[Kournan military]] garrison known as [[Morzek Garrison]] dominates the area, providing both security and trouble for the surrounding population. ==Getting there== Upon arrival at the [[Command Post]] for the first time, [[Dunkoro]] will offer a series of quests that will lead you here to build up the set of NPCs that will ultimately settle in the Command Post. ==Shrines==
